items.title: Pacific FC captain Josh Heard announces retirement
items.headline: Heard will be recognized by the club at their final regular season match.
items.summary:
Pacific FC captain Josh Heard announced on Wednesday that he will retire from professional soccer after this Sunday's final game in the Canadian Premier League regular season.

items.title: Report: New stadium at Wanderers Grounds would add $114.7 million in economic activity
items.headline: Assessment conducted by ATN Strategies found that Halifax Wanderers FC has contributed $83.3 million to the local economy
items.summary:
A new stadium at the Wanderers Grounds would generate $114.7 million in total economic activity for Nova Scotia, adding to the $83.3 million in economic impact the Wanderers have already generated since the club’s first season. That’s according to an economic-impact assessment conducted by Halifax-based ATN Strategies.
